honestLimits: Nothing was rendered or listened to: the evidence is plans, part tasks, note counts, the constraint engine and the plan-level critic. VALIDATED ON OUTPUT is not claimed for anything.

The reference composer does not realise thicken_voicing or drop_to_solo_before_last, ignores partWindow (staggered entries / exits exist in the plan only) and does not read formMemory / arcIntent; those are INTEGRATED-pending.

The plan-level critic's mean score on the synthetic benchmark fell 74.33 -> 73.0 (playability errors unchanged at 0). The drops are attributed above to composer idiom (16th hats at any tempo, the bass moving against a 1-and-3 kick) exposed by realistic densities, and to a critic that grades proxies without positive controls (F1 / F11); they were not designed around.
With the owner's brief the arc lands at pp verses because the brief compiler reads 'soft strings, gentle bass' as a global low-energy decision; that reading is upstream of this stream.
The intro of the owner's song is silent in every run (before and after) because its two bars carry no chord in the sheet; only the composer can anticipate the first chord.

The source recording still decides two things in the section planner: rhythmicActivity / melodicActivity (source onset and melody densities, used for role activity numbers and the OSTINATO rule when measured) and gapHeavy (arrangement-space windows). Both are labelled as measurements in the code but are not yet routed through the arc.

The ensemble intro / ending / transition figures were removed rather than re-homed (a real family already states the harmony at that instant; the runner's contract failed when the figure was stacked on the keys). The drum fill remains the realised transition device; per-family device realisation is B-04.

The 'before' half of this file was produced by running the 3bf23aa planners copied beside the new ones (same orchestrator, critic and composer), not from stored production runs; the stored v3 numbers of the owner's run are reproduced by the fixture within 0.06 and quoted from the diagnosis.
The keys track can still be constrained and performed as a drum kit whenever its first composed task is RHYTHMIC_HARMONY (musicEngines FAMILY_WORDS); only the part-request side is fixed here.
